title: StrenghtSmp-S4
description: Strenght smp S4 plugin Add custom weapong ability and strenghts
body:
Strenght smp S4 plugin and ability

join discord for texture pack https://discord.gg/4NjCREHc7z

Sword:Passive​
After landing a 3 hit combo on a player, your attacks become critical hits until you miss.
Ultimate​
Ability: After you hit a 5-hit combo, you can dual-wield swords, decreasing the attack cooldown by 50% for 15 seconds.


Axe:Passive​
Ability: After getting 5 critical hits with an axe, you can stun a player for 1 second.
Ultimate​
For 5 seconds your axe will not do any damage. However, after 5 seconds your next hit will do a lot of damage. The cooldown is 2 minutes.


Bow:Passive Ability​
Every third shot you land does double the damage that it would normally deal.
Ultimate Ability​
Every tenth shot you land does triple the damage than that it would normally do.
The cool-down is one minute.


Shield:Passive​
Taking a hit that disables your shield reduces incoming damage by 25% for 5 seconds.
Ultimate​
Become invincible for 15 seconds.


Crossbow:Passive​
Every 3 shots u do 2x Damage
Ultimate​
Get 5 hits to charge
Every hit pulls your enemy for 15 seconds

Trident:Passive​
Summons a lightning strike after you hit someone.
Every 2 hits
Ultimate​
The player can ride a wave for 5 seconds.
The wave pushes things away.
Cooldown is 1 minute.
After 3 hits



Commands:
/strenght:shows your weapon and strenght
/ability:activates ability
/withdraw:withdraw strenght and gives it as a item
/strenghtsmp info:gui with all weapons and u can take strenght and reroll(op only)
/strengthsmp reroll: rerolls a player of chose
/strenghtsmp setstrenght: set someone of chose strenght
/strenghtsmp setweapon: set someone of chose weapon
Report
